flows.name: Perform basic web search from homepage
flows.description: Verify that entering a search query into the search form and clicking Google Search triggers search execution.

steps.action: Focus the search input inside 'Google Search Form' and type 'Playwright testing'
steps.expectation: The search term appears in the search input box
The page navigates to the search results page displaying relevant web results

flows.expectation: Search query is submitted and relevant search results are presented to the user.

flows.name: Navigate using I'm Feeling Lucky button
flows.description: Test the 'I'm Feeling Lucky' interaction from the search homepage.

steps.expectation: The browser navigates directly to Google Doodles or a featured destination page

flows.expectation: User is redirected to the featured destination page without encountering an error.

flows.name: Navigate to Google account sign-in
flows.description: Ensure the Sign in link correctly directs visitors to the authentication flow.

steps.expectation: The browser navigates to the Google account sign-in interface

flows.expectation: Sign-in page loads with input fields for user credentials.

flows.name: Navigate section tabs on How Search Works page
flows.description: Verify that navigation links on the How Search Works page switch between key informational sections.

steps.expectation: Page scrolls or transitions to display the approach section
Page updates to present details on search mechanisms and algorithms
Features section content is visible and in view

flows.expectation: All section tabs navigate smoothly to their respective content areas without navigation errors.

flows.name: Interact with informational call-to-actions
flows.description: Verify that informative buttons on the How Search Works page provide deeper educational context.

steps.expectation: Detailed explanatory content or a related subpage opens

steps.action: Return or scroll to the media section and click 'Watch video'
steps.expectation: An embedded video player or media viewer is presented

flows.expectation: Educational interactive elements open and display their respective media or text content.

plan.notes: Search results may vary by geographic region, IP location, and user-agent settings.
